title: A House for the Smile
author: Xanthe Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Ashgrove, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
